Only line segments whose endpoints are both black dots are counted as roads; there are line segments crossing in the middle, but there is no black dot at the crossing, so it is not counted as a city or a road endpoint. raw_record.question_text: A map of Wonderland shows five cities. Each city is joined to every other city by a road. Alice's map, as shown, is incomplete. How many roads are missing?

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the five black dots as the five cities, and count only straight segments whose endpoints are black dots as roads; ignore the interior line crossing because there is no city dot there. Label the cities by position: left, top, lower-left, lower-right, and right. From the image, count 7 drawn roads among these five cities. From the text, every pair of cities should be joined by a road, so the completed map should be the complete graph on 5 cities. Compute the total required roads as C(5,2)=10, then subtract the 7 visible roads to get 3 missing roads.
